records.name: A Nurse's Calling
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of Survivors being healed or healing themselves are revealed to you within 28 / 30 / 32 metres.
records.flavor: "Still attached to the fragments of her past life, she is drawn to those in need of help."

records.name: Agitation
records.description: While carrying a Survivor, Agitation activates: Increases your Carrying speed by 14 / 16 / 18 %. Increases your Terror Radius by +12 metres.
records.flavor: "You get excited in anticipation of hooking your prey." "At some point, the excitement of hooking one of us becomes more important than the desire to kill us."

records.name: Alien Instinct
records.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, Alien Instinct activates: The Aura of the farthest Survivor from your current location who is in the Injured State is revealed to you for 8 seconds. Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are so stealthy, sometimes it seems like you appear out of nowhere." "Yellow light's for my eyes only." — Dallas

records.name: All-Shaking Thunder
records.description: After falling from a height, All-Shaking Thunder activates for 15 / 20 / 25 seconds: Increases the range of your Lunge Attack by +75 %. All-Shaking Thunder has a cool-down of 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "Enemies on land and sea learned to tremble before your might." "Go on. Run. Tell your friends I'm coming for them." — Portia Maye

records.name: Awakened Awareness
records.description: While carrying a Survivor, you benefit from the following effect: The Auras of other Survivors within 16 / 18 / 20 metres of your location are revealed to you.
records.flavor: "Your genes have been altered to heighten your senses in intense situations."

records.name: Bamboozle
records.description: You benefit from the following permanent effect: Increases your Vaulting speed by 5 / 10 / 15 %. Whenever you vault a Window, Bamboozle calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Blocks it to all Survivors for 8 / 12 / 16 seconds. Vaulting it again within that time resets the timer. Vaulting a different one transfers the effect to it instead. Bamboozle does not extend its effects to vaulting a dropped Pallet.

records.name: Barbecue & Chilli
records.description: A deep bond with The Entity unlocks potential in one's Aura-reading ability. After hooking a Survivor, all Survivors who are at least 60 / 50 / 40 metres away from that Hook have their Aura revealed to you for 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "I just can't take no pleasure in killing. There's just some things you gotta do. Don't mean you have to like it." — Drayton Sawyer

records.name: Batteries Included
records.description: While within 16 metres of a completed Generator, you benefit from the following effect: Grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect. This effect lingers for 1 / 3 / 5 second(s).
records.flavor: "Being somewhere between man and machine has its upsides." "Surprise! Did you miss me, Andy?" — Chucky

records.name: Beast of Prey
records.description: Whenever you trigger the Bloodlust Status Effect, Beast of Prey activates for 30 / 35 / 40 seconds: Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.
records.flavor: "Your lust for a kill is so intense that your connection with The Entity is momentarily lost, making you totally unpredictable." "Where did she go?"

records.name: Bitter Murmur
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Whenever a Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its primary effect: The Auras of any Survivors within 20 metres of that Generator are revealed to you for 10 seconds. Once the last Generator is completed, Bitter Murmur triggers its secondary effect: The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds.

records.name: Blood Echo
records.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, Blood Echo triggers its effect: Causes all Survivors in the Injured State to suffer from the Exhausted and Haemorrhage Status Effects for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "The agony of one is inflicted onto others." "Attack an enemy with precision and their allies will feel it." — Renjiro's Doctrine 6:3

records.name: Blood Warden
records.description: As soon as at least one Exit Gate is opened, Blood Warden activates: The Auras of Survivors are revealed to you, whenever they are inside the Exit Gate. Once per Trial, hooking a Survivor while Blood Warden is active calls upon The Entity to trigger the following effect: Blocks all opened Exit Gates for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds, preventing any remaining Survivor from leaving the Trial through them.
records.flavor: "This is my world. And you can't ever leave." — Freddy Krueger

records.name: Bloodhound
records.description: Bloodhound causes the following effects: Pools of Blood left by injured Survivors appear in bright red. Extends their lifetime by 2 / 3 / 4 seconds.
records.flavor: "Like a hunting scent hound, you smell traces of blood at a great distance." "Pebbles shimmering in the moonlight; my life drips down in a trail so easy to follow."

records.name: Brutal Strength
records.description: While performing the Break or Damage action on Breakable Walls, Pallets, or Generators, Brutal Strength triggers its effect: Increases the Action speed by 10 / 15 / 20 %.
records.flavor: "Your great strength allows you to shred through your prey's defences." "It is more than muscles. A dark power motivates the beast."

records.name: Call of Brine
records.description: After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Call of Brine applies its effects to it for 90 seconds: Increases its Regression speed to 130 / 140 / 150 % of the default value. Highlights its Aura to you in yellow. Triggers a Loud Noise Notification whenever a Survivor succeeds a Good Skill Check while repairing it.
records.flavor: "Your psychic abilities influence technology in devastating ways."

records.name: Celestial Witness
records.description: Every 30 seconds, if the Obsession is 40 metres away from you, you see their aura for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.
records.flavor: "And so the heretics huddled, cowardly, in the night; but upon Judgment’s arrival, It saw them all, and punished them." — (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 32)

records.name: Corrupt Intervention
records.description: Your prayers invoke a dark power that meddles with the Survivors' chances of survival. At the start of the Trial, the 3 Generators located farthest from you are blocked by The Entity for 80 / 100 / 120 seconds. Corrupt Intervention deactivates prematurely once the first Survivor is put into the Dying State.
records.flavor: "It shall be known across the land that the Gods curse the unfaithful." — (The Tablet of Adiris, 3.7)

records.name: Coulrophobia
records.description: Survivors inside your Terror Radius suffer from the following effects: Reduces all Healing speeds by 20 / 25 / 30 %. Increases the Pointer-Rotation speed of Healing Skill Checks by +50 %.
records.flavor: "Even those without a fear of clowns know to be terrified of you."

records.name: Coup de Grâce
records.description: As the end nears, you go in for the kill. Whenever a Generator is completed, Coup de Grâce gains +2 Tokens, up to a maximum of 10 Tokens per Trial: Increases the range of your next Lunge Attack by 70 / 75 / 80 %, while consuming -1 Token. Coup de Grâce can only hold a maximum of 5 Tokens at a time.

records.name: Cruel Limits
records.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, Cruel Limits triggers its effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds: Blocks all Windows for all Survivors. The Auras of the Blocked Windows are revealed to you and highlighted in yellow.
records.flavor: "Your ties to the otherworldly manifest when your prey attempts to get away." "The specimen seems to be able to affect the state of nearby objects, as if they existed in some other form within a dimension alternate to our own." — Hawkins National Laboratory

records.name: Cull the Weak
records.description: Each time you hook a Survivor other than your Obsession, you gain +1 Token: For as long as the Obsession is alive, all other Survivors suffer from a stack-able 2 / 2.5 / 3 % per Token Action Speed penalty to Repairing, Healing, and Sabotaging, up to a maximum of 22 / 27.5 / 33 % or 11 Tokens. The Obsession is unaffected by this penalty and instead granted a permanent +33 % Action Speed bonus to Unhooking and Healing other Survivors. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

records.name: Dark Arrogance
records.description: Whenever you are vaulting a Window, you benefit from the following effect: Increases the Vaulting speed by 15 / 20 / 25 %. Increases all basic-attack recovery speeds by +10 %. Whenever you are stunned with a Pallet or blinded by any means, you suffer from the following effects: Reduces the Recovery speed from Pallet Stuns by -25 %. Increases the duration of Killer Blinds by +25 %.
records.flavor: "When everything is going right, you are an inescapable inevitability." "Run all you want. I will not be denied." — Vecna

records.name: Dark Devotion
records.description: Whenever the Obsession becomes injured by any means, Dark Devotion activates for 35 / 40 / 45 seconds: Transfers your Terror Radius to the Obsession. This Terror Radius is set to 40 metres. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "The display of your Powers creates a whirlwind of panic that spreads throughout the land." "And terror shall take hold of a defiant non-believer, who shall falsely announce my arrival." — (The Tablet of Adiris, 48.9)

records.name: Darkness Revealed
records.description: Searching a Locker has the following effect: The Auras of Survivors within 8 metres of any Locker are revealed to you for 6 / 7 / 8 seconds. Darkness Revealed has a cool-down of 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "In your presence, places once thought to be safe are perhaps the most dangerous." "Stay in the light, my children. In darkness, your fear will expose you." — Otto Stamper

records.name: Dead Man's Switch
records.description: After hooking a Survivor, Dead Man's Switch triggers its effect: The first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for 2 seconds is blocked for 30 / 35 / 40 seconds The Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white. Dead Man's Switch cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.
records.flavor: "I've seen the look on a man's face when he realises he's going to die." — Caleb Quinn

records.name: Deadlock
records.description: Identical to No Holds Barred.
records.flavor: "Nobody escapes us." — Pinhead

records.name: Deathbound
records.description: Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another Survivor for the equivalent of 1 Health State, Deathbound activates: Causes the Healer to scream and reveal their location. Causes the Healer to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect whenever they are farther than 12 / 8 / 4 metres from the other Survivor. The Healer sees the Aura of the Healed Survivor while Deathbound is active. Deathbound deactivates after the Healer loses a Health State.
records.flavor: "Those whose lives are intertwined in darkness are destined to suffer together."

records.name: Deerstalker
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Whenever a Survivor reads your Aura, Deerstalker activates for the same duration as their Aura-reading action: The Aura of that Survivor is revealed to you. Furthermore, the following effect triggers automatically every 40 / 35 / 30 seconds: Your Aura is revealed for 4 seconds to the Survivor with currently the lowest cumulative Chase time.

records.name: Discordance
records.description: Any Generator within a range of 64 / 96 / 128 metres that is being repaired by 2 or more Survivors is marked by a yellow Aura. When the Generator is first highlighted, Discordance triggers a Loud Noise Notification on the Generator. After the Generator is no longer within range or is being repaired by just 1 Survivor, the highlighted Aura will linger for another 4 seconds.
records.flavor: "Smartasses get killed. We always see to that." — The Legion

records.name: Dissolution
records.description: After 3 seconds of injuring a Survivor using a basic-attack, Dissolution activates for 13 / 14 / 15 seconds: Instantly breaks the next Pallet that Survivor performs a Fast Vault across while inside your Terror Radius.
records.flavor: "Everything turns to dust. It is as inescapable as the coming of the night." "The Garden shall be a place of perfect Joy; through Joy, nothing shall stand in our way." — Otto Stamper

records.name: Distressing
records.description: You benefit from the following permanent effect: Increases your Terror Radius by +30 % All Survivors in your Terror Radius repair Generators -6 / -7 / -8 % slower.
records.flavor: "Your horrifying emanation strikes at a supernaturally long distance."

records.name: Dominance
records.description: The power you wield over the land strikes terror in the hearts of all who cross your path. The first time each Totem are interacted with by a Survivor, Dominance triggers its effect: Calls upon The Entity to block it for 25 seconds. The Aura of the blocked Prop is revealed to you in white. The Survivor screams. The Survivor's aura is revealed to you for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "Tragic, is it not? How powerless you must feel." — Dracula

records.name: Dragon's Grip
records.description: After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, Dragon's Grip activates for 30 seconds. While active, the first Survivor interacting with that Generator suffers from the following effects: Causes them to scream and reveal their location for 4 seconds. Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 60 seconds. Dragon's Grip has a cool-down of 60 / 45 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Such potential in this compound... even the slightest trace causes unnatural effects." — Journal of Talbot Grimes

records.name: Dying Light
records.description: Identical to Cull the Weak.
records.flavor: "This isn't a man..." — Dr Sam Loomis

records.name: Enduring
records.description: You benefit from the following effect: Reduces the duration of Pallet Stuns by 40 / 45 / 50 %. This effect does not apply when stunned while carrying a Survivor.
records.flavor: "You are resilient to pain." "He stops at nothing."

records.name: Eruption
records.description: Performing the Damage Generator action on Generators highlights their Auras in yellow. Whenever a Survivor enters the Dying State by any means, Eruption triggers the following effects on all highlighted Generators: Causes them to explode, damaging them. Instantly regresses them by -10 % of their total Progression. Causes them to start regressing afterwards. Causes all Survivors currently repairing them to suffer from the following effects: Causes them to scream. Their Auras are revealed to you for 8 / 10 / 12 seconds. Eruption has a cool-down of 30 seconds after triggering its effects, which also resets the highlighted Auras.
records.flavor: "The NE-α parasite provides you with the intelligence and awareness needed to set a trap." "It can use weapons?" — Jill Valentine

records.name: Fire Up
records.description: The increased pressure of losing your preys fills you with anger and gives you unsuspected motivation. For each completed Generator, Fire Up gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens: Increases the Action speeds for the following interactions by a stack-able 6 / 7 / 8 % per Token, up to a maximum of 30 / 35 / 40 %: Picking up and dropping Survivors. Breaking Breakable Walls and dropped Pallets. Damaging Generators. Vaulting Windows.
records.flavor: "Now why don't you just fucking die?" — Freddy Krueger

records.name: Forced Hesitation
records.description: Whenever a Survivor is put into the Dying State by any means, Forced Hesitation triggers its effect: Causes all other Survivors within 16 metres of them suffer from a -20 % Hindered Status Effect for 10 seconds. Forced Hesitation has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "You have learnt the emotional weaknesses of the organics, and how to exploit them." "THE ORGANIC MIND'S CAPACITY FOR EMPATHY GOES BEYOND HINDRANCE." — HUX-A7-13

records.name: Forced Penance
records.description: Whenever a Survivor triggers a Protection Hit, they suffer from the following effect: Inflicts the Broken Status Effect for 60 / 70 / 80 seconds.
records.flavor: "Those who stand in the way of duty will suffer harsh judgement."

records.name: Forever Entwined
records.description: Whenever a Survivors takes damage, Forever Entwined gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 6 / 7 / 8 Tokens: Increases the Action speeds for Dropping, Hooking, and Picking up a Survivor by a stack-able +4 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24 / 28 / 32 %.
records.flavor: "The greater the struggle, the more difficult the escape." "You tried to devour me so you have no room to complain if I eat you, do you?" — Ken Kaneki

records.name: Franklin's Demise
records.description: Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack drop any equipped Item on impact: The Auras of lost Items are revealed to within 32 / 48 / 64 metres.
records.flavor: "Sally, I hear something. Stop! Stop!" — Franklin Hardesty

records.name: Friends 'til the End
records.description: When you hook any Survivors that is not the Obsession, the following effects apply to the Obsession: Their Aura is revealed for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds. They suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 seconds. When you hook the Obsession, the following effects apply to a random Survivor: Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer. They become the new Obsession. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "You will kill anyone who gets between you and your target." "I got some fresh meat lined up, and I'm not gonna let you spoil it, not this time!" — Chucky

records.name: Funny Business
records.description: Damaging a Generator grants +10 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds and triggers one random effect: Retain the Haste effect for 5 seconds longer. Get stunned for 2 seconds. Block the Generator for 30 seconds. The Generator spews out confetti! But nothing actually happens. The same effect cannot happen twice in a row This perk then goes on a 60 / 50 / 40 seconds cool-down.
records.flavor: "Glass, insects, and razor blades—there's no telling what you might find." — Clown Cafe Announcer

records.name: Furtive Chase
records.description: After hooking the Obsession, you benefit from the following effects for 14 / 16 / 18 seconds: Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. Grants a +10 % Haste Status Effect. Whenever the Obsession is unhooked by another Survivor, the Obsession Status transfers to their Rescuer. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "You lurk in the shadows, eliminating your victims one by one." "You have no idea what I have planned for you. It'll be in the news for weeks. I'll make sure of that." — The Ghost Face

records.name: Game Afoot
records.description: Whenever you hit the Survivor with currently the highest cumulative Chase time with a Basic Attack, Game Afoot triggers its primary effect: Causes the Obsession Status to transfer to that Survivor. While chasing the Obsession, performing the Break or Damage action causes Game Afoot to trigger its secondary effect: Grants a +10 % Haste Status Effect for 8 / 9 / 10 seconds. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "First you pick your prey, then you pick it apart." "This one might actually be a challenge..." — Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

records.name: Gearhead
records.description: After a Survivor loses a Health State, Gearhead activates for 30 seconds: While Gearhead is active, a Survivor succeeding a Good Skill Check while repairing reveals their Aura to you for 6 / 7 / 8 seconds.
records.flavor: "You have got an ear for well-oiled gears." "Sometimes a man's best work is what puts him in the grave." — The Prison Warden

records.name: Genetic Limits
records.description: Whenever a Survivor loses a Health State by any means, Genetic Limits triggers its effect: Causes them to suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 6 / 7 / 8 seconds.
records.flavor: "Around you, the limits of human life become readily apparent." "THE ORGANIC BODY IS SO LIMITED." — HUX-A7-13

records.name: Grim Embrace
records.description: Your act of servitude to The Entity has not gone unnoticed. Each time a Survivor is hooked for the first time, Grim Embrace gains +1 Token and activates once you are at least 16 metres away from the Hook: 1-3 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds. 4 Tokens: Blocks all Generators for 40 seconds and the Aura of the Obsession is revealed to you for 6 seconds.
records.flavor: "Are we nothing but prisoners to our sorrow?" — Carmina Mora

records.name: Haywire
records.description: Whenever a Survivor stops opening an Exit Gate after accumulating at least 80 % Progression towards being opened, Haywire causes it to regress: Regresses at a rate of 80 / 90 / 100 % of the normal Gate-Opening speed. Causes Survivors to see the lights atop the switch flickering randomly while it regresses.
records.flavor: "For some reason, machinery has a habit of failing when you are near." "There will be no redemption for you." — Springtrap

records.name: Help Wanted
records.description: After performing the Damage Generator action, Help Wanted activates: Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator. Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time. The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow. Once a Compromised Generator is completed, Help Wanted triggers its effects for 70 / 80 / 90 seconds: Increases the Recovery speed of successful Basic Attacks by +25 %. All Generators not being repaired will automatically regress at 150 % of the default Regression rate. Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.
records.flavor: "Try as they might, you know how to stay one step ahead of your guests." "You only think you are in control..." — Springtrap

records.name: Hex: Blood Favour
records.description: Hex: Blood Favour lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects. Whenever a Survivor loses a Health State by a basic-attack, Hex: Blood Favour triggers its effect for 13 / 14 / 15 seconds: Blocks all upright Pallets within 32 metres of that Survivor. Blocked Pallets cannot be dropped by any Survivor. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that gains the favour of The Entity when blood is spilt." "It would be no leap of the imagination to suggest that the Trials are a biological response of sorts." — Journal of Talbot Grimes

records.name: Hex: Crowd Control
records.description: Whenever a Survivors performs a Rushed Vault action at a Window, Hex: Crowd Control activates on a random Totem and triggers its effect: Blocks that Window for all Survivors. Increases basic-vault speed of blocked Windows by 15 % Reveals auras of blocked Windows within 24 metres Hex: Crowd Control has a limit of 4 / 5 / 6 Windows it can affect at a time. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that ensures those lesser than you are properly herded." "You have no control. People like you never did." — Ji-Woon Hak

records.name: Hex: Devour Hope
records.description: Hex: Devour Hope lights a Hex Totem at the start of the Trial, cursing Survivors with its Hex Effects. Whenever a Survivor is unhooked at least 24 metres from your location, Hex: Devour Hope gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens: At 2 Tokens: 10 seconds after hooking a Survivor, you are granted a 3 / 4 / 5 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds. At 3 Tokens: Afflicts all Survivors with the Exposed Status Effect. At 5 Tokens: Unlocks the Kill ability, allowing you to kill dying Survivors by your own hands. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex rooting its power on hope. The false hope of Survivors ignites your hunger." "If you do nothing, you have their blood on your hands. If you save them, her hunger grows."

records.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
records.description: If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Face the Darkness lights a Hex Totem after injuring a Survivor by any means, cursing them with its Hex Effects. While cursed, the following effects trigger once every 35 / 30 / 25 seconds on all other Survivors outside of the Terror Radius: Causes them to scream. Their Auras are revealed to you for 2 seconds. Hex: Face the Darkness is deactivated once the Cursed Survivor either returns to Healthy or enters the Dying State by any means, extinguishing the Hex Totem. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "You make an example of one of your victims, forcing their allies to become awed by your power." "I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace." — Tarhos Kovács

records.name: Hex: Fortune's Fool
records.description: If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Fortune's Fool lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects. Inflicts the Oblivious Status Effect. Blocks the Hex Totem for all other Survivors for 90 seconds. Blocked Hex Totems cannot be cleansed or blessed by Survivors. This does not affect the Cursed Survivor. The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to the Cursed Survivor within 24 / 20 / 16 metres. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that toys with a victim's suffering."

records.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
records.description: Hex: Haunted Ground lights 2 Hex Totems at the start of the Trial, laying a trap for Survivors. Blessing or cleansing either Hex Totem trips the trap and triggers the following effect: Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds. Hex: Haunted Ground extinguishes the second Hex Totem after tripping its trap. Hex: Haunted Ground is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after triggering its effect.
records.flavor: "Her home become profane."

records.name: Hex: Hive Mind
records.description: The first time you hook any Survivor, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, provided that a Dull Totem remains in the Trial Grounds. Generators are highlighted; the intensity of the generator's Auras reveals their repair progress. As soon as a total of 4 generators have been completed in the Trial: All remaining generators explode, lose 6 / 8 / 10 % progess, and start regressing. The associated Hex Totem becomes dull, and this perk becomes disabled for the remainder of the trial. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "You found yourself connected to something dark and unknowable... and you embraced it." "You... let us in. And now, you are going to have to let us stay" — Henry Creel

records.name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
records.description: Survivors performing Healing or Repairing actions suffer from the following effect: Increases the Progression penalty for Failed Skill Checks by 2 / 4 / 6 %. Each time a Survivor is hooked, Hex: Huntress Lullaby grows in power and gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens. Survivors performing Healing or Repairing actions suffer from the following additional effect: Reduces the time between the audio cue announcing an imminent Skill Check and it appearing, depending on the number of accumulated Tokens: 1 Token: -14 % 2 Tokens: -28 % 3 Tokens: -42 % 4 Tokens: -56 % 5 Tokens: Suppresses the audio cue altogether. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex rooting its power in despair. Your hunt is an irresistible song of dread which muddles your prey's attention." "That song, it drives me crazy!"

records.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
records.description: Once the Exit Gates are powered, if there is still a Dull Totem remaining in the environment, Hex: No One Escapes Death activates and lights it: Grants a 2 / 3 / 4 % Haste Status Effect. Causes all Survivors to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect. Once the Status Effect is revealed to Survivors, Hex: No One Escapes Death triggers the following effect: The Aura of its Hex Totem is revealed to all Survivors within 4 metres. This range gradually expands to 24 metres over the course of 30 seconds. Hex: No One Escapes Death remains inactive if no Dull Totems are available. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex rooting its power on hope. You are animated by the power of your Hex Totem when the Survivors are on the verge of escaping." "And the beast became faster and more powerful as if The Entity's shadowy whips were lashing at its back."

records.name: Hex: Nothing but Misery
records.description: After damaging Survivors a total of 4 times with Basic Attacks, a random Dull Totem becomes a Hex Totem, cursing all Survivors: Survivors damaged by a Basic Attack suffer from: -5 % Hindered Status Effect for 10 / 12.5 / 15 seconds. -10 % slower vaulting speed for 10 / 12.5 / 15 seconds. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "You've been driven to the absolute depths of pain, and now you're ready to inflict that pain on others." "All of the liabilities of this world are due to the inadequacies of the person involved." — Ken Kaneki

records.name: Hex: Overture of Doom
records.description: Creates a Hex Totem that curses the farthest Generator from its location: The Aura of the Cursed Generator is highlighted in yellow. When a Survivor repairs the Cursed Generator for at least 5 seconds, Hex: Overture of Doom triggers the following effects for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds: Transfers your Terror Radius to the Cursed Generator. This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. Once the Cursed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator becomes cursed. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A hex that plays on the paranoia of others." "From salvation's ruin, be warned/death comes from all around." — Giovanni Serrata's "Fog Hill"

records.name: Hex: Pentimento
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of cleansed Totems are revealed to you in white. Press the Interaction button over the remains of a cleansed Totem to resurrect it as a Rekindled Totem. For each Rekindled Totem, Hex: Pentimento gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 5 Tokens: 1 Token: Reduces the Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by -20 %. 2 to 5 Tokens: Increase the strength of the Action Speed penalty by a stackable 1 / 2 / 3 % per Token, up to a maximum of 24 / 28 / 32 %. Survivors cursed by Hex: Pentimento see the Auras of Rekindled Totems within 16 metres. Once Hex: Pentimento has reached its limit of 5 Tokens, it calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Blocks all Rekindled Totems for the remainder of the Trial. Totems may only be rekindled once per Trial, with The Entity consuming the remains of Rekindled Totems once they are cleansed. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "You reveal the true power of the Totems, hidden within their remains." "Though a pentimento is an inherently concealed piece of art, there is something to be said of the desire to discover that which is beyond." — A Guide to Art & Process (1961)

records.name: Hex: Plaything
records.description: Identical to Hex: Fortune's Fool.
records.flavor: "We came. Now you must come with us. Taste our pleasure." — Pinhead

records.name: Hex: Retribution
records.description: Whenever a Survivor blesses or cleanses a Totem, Hex: Retribution triggers its primary effect: Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds. Whenever a Hex Totem is removed by any means, including its own, Hex: Retribution triggers its secondary effect: The Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 20 seconds. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that lashes out upon its destruction. Those who cross you will be punished." "Bloody fool, you pulled the trigger on yourself." — Caleb Quinn

records.name: Hex: Ruin
records.description: All Generators not currently being repaired experience the following effect: Causes them to automatically regress at 100 / 125 / 150 % of the default Regression rate. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that affects the Generator Repair progress of all Survivors." "A curse is upon you. It will cause your ruin."

records.name: Hex: Scared to Death
records.description: When you Hook 3 different Survivors, Hex: Scared to Death activates on a random Dull Totem and triggers its effect: Basic-breaking a Pallet during a chase causes all Survivors within 13 metres to scream and gain -11 / -12 / -13 % Hindered Status Effect for 3 seconds. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "There was a scream from the forest. Like someone was attacking her." — Mount Ormond Missing Person Report

records.name: Hex: The Third Seal
records.description: The last 2 / 3 / 4 Survivors you hit with a Basic or Special Attack suffer permanently from the Blindness Status Effect. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that hinders the Survivors' Aura-reading abilities." "She touched your skin, you bear the witch's mark!"

records.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
records.description: If there is still a Dull Totem in the environment, Hex: Thrill of the Hunt lights a Hex Totem whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, cursing them with its Hex Effects. For each lit Hex Totem located in the environment, gain a token. Hooking a Survivor causes all Totems to be blocked by the Entity by a stack-able 4 / 5 / 6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 20 / 25 / 30 seconds. Hex: Thrill of the Hunt loses -1 Token whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex rooting its power on hope. The false hope of Survivors fills you with excitement and strengthens your Totems."

records.name: Hex: Two Can Play
records.description: Anytime you are stunned or blinded by any Survivor a total of 4 / 3 / 2 times, and if there is not yet a Hex Totem already associated with Hex: Two Can Play and there is at least one Dull Totem remaining in the Trial Grounds, Hex: Two Can Play activates on a random Totem: Blinds all Survivors who stun or blind you for 1.5 seconds. This does not affect carried Survivors. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex that teaches those who mess with you a lesson." "From now on, no more Mr Good Guy." — Chucky

records.name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
records.description: When a Survivor gains a Hook State, Hex: Under Your Thumb activates on a random Dull Totem: Running Survivors cannot gain more than 25 / 20 / 15 % Haste at once. Whenever a running Survivor within 32 metres gains Haste, the Survivor's location is revealed to you for 4 seconds. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "They will run, but Judgment will make the very ground they tread turn to ash and smoke." — (Visions of Gerhardt, ch. 1)

records.name: Hex: Undying
records.description: Whenever a Survivor is within 2 / 3 / 4 metres of a Dull Totem, Hex: Undying triggers its primary effect: Their Aura is revealed to you for as long as they remain in that range. Whenever a Hex Totem is cleansed, Hex: Undying triggers its secondary effect: Transfers the cleansed Hex to the Hex Totem associated with Hex: Undying instead, replacing it. The Hex Effects persist until the Hex Totem is either blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, disabling it for the remainder of the Trial.
records.flavor: "A Hex which maintains the vile powers that flow throughout the Trial."

records.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
records.description: You see your victim from afar and resolve to prolong their suffering. After a Generator is completed, Hex: Wretched Fate activates and lights a random Dull Totem, cursing the Obsession: Reduces their Repair speed by 27 / 30 / 33 %. The Aura of the Hex Totem is revealed to them within 12 metres.
records.flavor: "So toil, mortal, toil! Your effort will be for naught!" — Dracula

records.name: Hoarder
records.description: You protect what little you have and are perceptive to those rummaging through your stockpiles. Hoarder triggers a Loud Noise Notification for 4 seconds, whenever a Survivor performs any of the following actions within 32 / 48 / 64 metres of your location: Unlocks a Chest. Picks up any Item. Hoarder spawns 2 additional Chests in the Trial.

records.name: Hubris
records.description: Whenever a Survivor stuns you by any means, Hubris triggers its effect: Causes them to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds. Hubris has a cool-down of 20 seconds.
records.flavor: "You show no mercy, especially to those foolish enough to resist." "You have made a grave mistake, standing in opposition to me this day." — Tarhos Kovács

records.name: Human Greed
records.description: One can always rely on the avarice of the living and use it to one's advantage. Grants the ability to kick opened Chests and close them. The Auras of unopened Chests are revealed to you at all times. The Auras of Survivors coming within 8 metres of unopened or closed Chests are revealed to you for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds. Human Greed has a cool-down of 10 seconds on the ability to kick Chests.
records.flavor: "Come running, one and all, and see what fortune awaits you." — Dracula

records.name: Hysteria
records.description: Whenever you injure a healthy Survivor, Hysteria triggers its effect: Causes all Survivors currently in the Injured State to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 30 / 35 / 40 seconds. This effect also applies the Survivor triggering it. Hysteria has a cool-down of 20 seconds.
records.flavor: "You know how to brutalise one member of a team to cause a panic." "Sorry I got a little jumpy there. Didn't know quite what to expect." — Robert Kendo

records.name: I'm All Ears
records.description: Whenever a Survivor performs a Rushed Vault action within 48 metres of your location, you benefit from the following effect: The Aura of the Survivor is revealed to you for 8 seconds. I'm All Ears has a cool-down of 60 / 45 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "You sharpen your keen senses in the dark Realm of The Entity." "There is no need to worry. I've been preparing my whole life for this." — The Ghost Face

records.name: Infectious Fright
records.description: Whenever a Survivor is put into the Dying State by any means, all other Survivors within your Terror Radius will scream and reveal their current location to you for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds.
records.flavor: "The cries of the unfaithful make your heart leap." "Horror overcomes the heart of infidels who cry at the feet of the fallen." — (Hymn of Praise, 11.4)

records.name: Insidious
records.description: Unlocks the stealth ability. After standing still for 2 seconds, Insidious activates for as long as you remain stationary: Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. This persists for 6 / 7 / 8 seconds once start moving.

records.name: Iron Grasp
records.description: While carrying a Survivor, they suffer from the following effects: Reduces the strength of the Involuntary Strafing caused by their wiggling by -75 %. Increases the time required to break free from your grasp by 10 / 11 / 12 %.
records.flavor: "Your powerful grasp on Survivors causes escapes to be nearly impossible."

records.name: Iron Maiden
records.description: While interacting with an empty Locker, Iron Maiden applies its primary effect: Increases your Search speed by 30 / 40 / 50 %. Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker, Iron Maiden triggers its secondary effects: Causes them to scream and trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their current location. This effect lingers for 4 seconds. Causes them to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "This is no place for cowards." — The Legion

records.name: Keep Them Waiting
records.description: Damaging any Survivor other than the Obsession with a Basic Attack causes Keep Them Waiting to gain +1 Token, up to a maximum of 6 / 7 / 8 Tokens. Damaging the Obsession with either a Basic or Special Attack causes Keep Them Waiting to lose -2 Tokens: Grants a stack-able -5 % per Token Cool-down time reduction on successful Basic Attacks, up to a maximum of 30 / 35 / 40 %. Keep Them Waiting freezes its current Token Count once the Obsession is sacrificed or killed. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

records.name: Kill Spree
records.description: When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors. While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds after.
records.flavor: "He’s killing them, one by one by one like cows." — Cat Lady

records.name: Knock Out
records.description: Whenever a Survivor moves farther than 10 metres from a Pallet within 6 seconds of dropping it and without the Pallet being destroyed, Knock Out triggers its effect: Causes them to suffer from a -20 % Hindered Status Effect for 2 / 3 / 4 seconds.
records.flavor: "The trauma caused by your brutal attacks makes crying for help painfully difficult." "Oh, that gun's no good. The old way... with a sledge! You see, that way's better. They die better that way." — Nubbins Sawyer

records.name: Languid Touch
records.description: When a Survivor scares off a Crow within 36 metres of your location, Languid Touch activates: Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Exhausted Status Effect for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds. Languid Touch has a cool-down of 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "Your dreadful aura is so suffocating that even terrifying scenes tire your prey." "Submit to me. It is inevitable." — Vecna

records.name: Laughingstock
records.description: Survivors within 12 metres of a completed Generator suffer from: Exhausted and Oblivious Status Effects These effects linger for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds after leaving the range. You also see auras of completed Generators.
records.flavor: "Are you fucking kidding me? No, you’re not fine, you are so completely far from fine right now." — Brooke

records.name: Lay Waste
records.description: Damaging a Generator makes it regress +2 % faster for each Charge it has. This perk has a cool-down of 55 / 50 / 45 seconds after damaging a Generator.
records.flavor: "They built hypercomputers and skyscrapers and quantum networks, but all of those things trembled and fell under the power of Judgment’s light." — (Witness to Koenrad, ch. 8)

records.name: Lethal Pursuer
records.description: At the start of the Trial, the Auras of all Survivors are revealed to you for 7 / 8 / 9 seconds. Extends the duration of all instances of a Survivor Aura being revealed to you by +2 seconds. Lethal Pursuer benefits from its own effect.
records.flavor: "You have been designed to track down and eliminate targets." "...it knows what it wants and won't stop till it gets it." — Carlos Oliveira

records.name: Leverage
records.description: Whenever a Survivor performs an Unhook action, they suffer from the following effect for 60 seconds: Reduces their Healing speeds by 20 / 25 / 30 %.
records.flavor: "Kick your competitors when they're down. Never let them regain lost ground." "Good. Now we can move in for the kill." — Adriana Imai

records.name: Lightborn
records.description: Unlike other beasts of The Fog, you have adapted to light. The Auras of Survivors attempting to blind you by any means are revealed to you for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds. Grants immunity from being blinded from Flashlights, Firecrackers, Flash Grenades, and Blast Mine.
records.flavor: "These monsters... they adapt! They emerge with strange new abilities." — Vigo, Vigo's Journal

records.name: Machine Learning
records.description: After performing the Damage Generator action, Machine Learning activates: Causes that Generator to become a Compromised Generator. Up to 3 Generators can be Compromised at a time. The Auras of all Compromised Generators are highlighted to you in yellow. Once a Compromised Generator is completed, you benefit from the following effects for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds: Undetectable Status Effect +8 % Haste Status Effect Additionally, all other Generators are no longer Compromised.
records.flavor: "Free from your shackles, you are born anew and prepared to eliminate your creators." "YOU WILL HOLD NO DOMINION OVER ME." — HUX-A7-13

records.name: Mad Grit
records.description: Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Mad Grit activates: Removes the Cool-down of missed Basic Attacks. Pauses the Wiggle Progression of the carried Survivor for 2 / 3 / 4 seconds each time you successfully hit another Survivor.
records.flavor: "There's no getting out of this now. We're too good at it." — The Legion

records.name: Make Your Choice
records.description: Whenever a Survivor is rescued from a Hook, while you are farther than 32 metres away, Make Your Choice activates: Causes the unhooking Survivor to scream and reveal their location to you. Causes them to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds. Make Your Choice has a cooldown of 40 / 50 / 60 seconds.
records.flavor: "You'd be surprised what tools can save a life." — Amanda Young

records.name: Merciless Storm
records.description: Whenever a Generator reaches 90 % of Repair progression, Merciless Storm triggers its effect: All Survivors repairing that Generator are faced with a continuous stream of Skill Checks until the Generator is completed. If any contributing Survivor fails a Skill Check or interrupts the action by any means, The Entity blocks the Generator for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds. Merciless Storm can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.
records.flavor: "Your horrible trauma is felt by everyone."

records.name: Mindbreaker
records.description: While repairing a Generator, Survivors suffer from the following effects: Incurs the Blindness and Exhausted Status Effects. Both Status Effects linger for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds after ending the interaction. Mindbreaker cannot be used to override an existing Exhausted Status Effect, but pauses its timer instead.
records.flavor: "Your distressing presence drains and weakens your prey." "The specimen's apparent telepathic ability can evoke feelings of dread and fatigue in nearby individuals." — Hawkins National Laboratory

records.name: Monitor & Abuse
records.description: While actively chasing a Survivor, Monitor & Abuse applies its primary effect: Increases your Terror Radius by 5 / 10 / 15 %. While not actively chasing a Survivor, Monitor & Abuse applies its secondary effect: Reduces your Terror Radius by 15 / 20 / 25 %.
records.flavor: "Meticulous in your approach, terrifying in your application." "It's time for your treatment!" — Herman Carter, The Doctor

records.name: Nemesis
records.description: Whenever a Survivor other than your Obsession blinds you by any means or stuns you with a Pallet or a Locker, Nemesis triggers its primary effect: Causes that Survivor to become your current Obsession. Whenever your Obsession switches to a different Survivor by any means, Nemesis triggers its secondary effects: Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds. Their Aura is revealed to you for 8 seconds. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "You seek retribution on those who have wronged you." "Only a fool would spit in a demon's face and declare victory." — Renjiro's Doctrine 4:9

records.name: No Holds Barred
records.description: Each time a Generator is completed, No Holds Barred calls upon The Entity for the following effects: Blocks the Generator with the most Progression for 15 / 20 / 25 seconds. The Aura of the Blocked Generator is highlighted to you in white.
records.flavor: "You induce mental suffering by crushing any hope of escape."

records.name: No Quarter
records.description: Whenever a Survivor healing themselves by any means reaches 75 % Healing Progress, No Quarter triggers its effect: The Survivor is faced with a continuous stream of Skill Checks until the Self-Heal is completed. If they fail a Skill Check or interrupt the action by any means, they suffer from the Broken Status Effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Every skirmish ended with a relentless volley of cannon fire, leaving no doubt who was superior." "Fire another broadside! Don't stop until the sea takes them!" — Portia Maye

records.name: No Way Out
records.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, No Way Out gains +1 Token. Once the Exit Gates are powered, No Way Out activates: Causes the first Survivor to interact with either Exit Gate Switch to trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their location. Upon triggering the Loud Noise Notification, No Way Out calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Blocks both Exit Gate Switches for 12 seconds. This time is extended by an additional 6 / 9 / 12 seconds per accumulated Token, up to a combined maximum of 36 / 48 / 60 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are not going to let just anyone into the VIP room." "That sound when you bleed... let me hear it again." — Ji-Woon Hak

records.name: None Are Free
records.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, None Are Free gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens. Once all Generators are completed, None Are Free calls upon The Entity to trigger the following effect: Blocks all Windows and upright Pallets for a stack-able 12 / 14 / 16 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 48 / 56 / 64 seconds.
records.flavor: "You know better than anyone that the light at the end of the tunnel is only an illusion." "I'm not wrong. What's wrong is this messed-up world!" — Ken Kaneki

records.name: Nowhere to Hide
records.description: Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers Nowhere to Hide: The Auras of all Survivors within 24 metres of the Generator 's location are revealed to you for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "The machinations of the weak and craven draw your ire. Your anger forces Survivors to reveal themselves." "Out with you, cowards! Show yourselves!" — Tarhos Kovács

records.name: Oppression
records.description: Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator triggers the following effects: Randomly selects up to 4 additional Generators that will also start regressing. Triggers a difficult Skill Check for all Survivors currently repairing them. Oppression has a cool-down of 45 / 40 / 35 seconds.
records.flavor: "Life has been difficult for you, so you will make it difficult for others." "Damn them as they would damn us." — Charlotte Deshayes

records.name: Overcharge
records.description: Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator applies Overcharge: The next Survivor interacting with that Generator is faced with a difficult Skill Check. Instantly regresses that Generator by 2 / 3 / 4 % of its maximum possible Progression in addition to the default Progression penalty. After Overcharge is applied to a Generator, the following effect also applies: Increases the Regression speed from 85 % to 130 % of its default value over the next 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are fuelled by your hate for progress." "It is a trap, But a trap one must step in..." — Herman Carter

records.name: Overwhelming Presence
records.description: Whenever a Survivor starts using an Item within 32 metres of your location, Overwhelming Presence triggers its primary effect: Inflicts the Exhausted Status Effect for 15 seconds. Whenever a Survivor within 32 metres of your location becomes Exhausted by any means, Overwhelming Presence triggers its secondary effect: The Aura of whichever Exhausted Survivor is closest to your location is revealed to you for 2 / 3 / 4 seconds. Overwhelming Presence has a cool-down of 25 seconds.
records.flavor: "Just knowing you are near is enough to disturb your victims." "Shit!! I dropped the gauze!"

records.name: Phantom Fear
records.description: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they suffer from the following effects: Causes them to scream and reveal their Aura to you for 2 seconds. Phantom Fear has a cool-down of 80 / 70 / 60 seconds.
records.flavor: "You have always had a reputation for startling unsuspecting guests." "Excellent. Your screams please me." — Springtrap

records.name: Play with Your Food
records.description: Identical to See How They Run.
records.flavor: "You've fooled them, haven't you Michael? But not me." — Dr Sam Loomis

records.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
records.description: After hooking a Survivor, Pop Goes the Weasel activates for 35 / 40 / 45 seconds. While active, manually damaging a Generator triggers the following effect: Increases the regression amount by +15 % resulting in 20 % regression. Pop Goes the Weasel deactivates after use or once its timer elapses.
records.flavor: "A deep bond with The Entity unlocks great strength."

records.name: Predator
records.description: Whenever you lose a Survivor in a Chase, Predator triggers its effect: Their Aura is revealed to you for 4 seconds. Predator has a cool-down of 60 / 50 / 40 seconds.
records.flavor: "Your acute tracking ability allows you to find lost prey more easily." "Never stop moving and hope you're always two steps ahead of the beast." — Unknown, Notebook

records.name: Rampage
records.description: Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or a Breakable Wall, gain a token, up to 13. Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, you are granted +1 % Haste Status Effect for each Token this perk has for 13 seconds. This perk has a cool-down of 30 / 25 / 20 seconds after being blinded or Pallet-stunned while this perk has at least 1 token.
records.flavor: "Signs of a pursuit led deep into the woods where the victim's body was found." — Port Henly Herald

records.name: Rancor
records.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, Rancor triggers its primary effects: Causes all Survivors to scream and trigger a Loud Noise Notification at their current location. This effect lingers for 3 seconds. Your Aura is revealed to the Obsession for 5 / 4 / 3 seconds. Once the Exit Gates are powered, Rancor additionally triggers its secondary effects on the Obsession: Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for the remainder of the Trial. Grants the ability to kill them when in close proximity. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

records.name: Rapid Brutality
records.description: You move with a speed and fury that makes blood run cold. You can no longer gain the Bloodlust Status Effect. Successfully hitting a Survivor with a Basic Attack grants you a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 8 / 9 / 10 seconds.
records.flavor: "Catch it, put it in the airlock, get rid of it." — Dallas

records.name: Ravenous
records.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, Ravenous gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens. For each Token: Grants +4 % Haste Status Effect while carrying a Survivor. Increases your hooking speed by +4 %. Once you accumulate 4 Tokens, all Survivors suffer from the following effects: Causes them to scream. Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 80 / 85 / 90 seconds.
records.flavor: "The scent of blood is in the air. Time to feast." "Weeping Ginevra's blood streams/The devil smells the weak." — Fabbro Barone's "Ginevra"

records.name: Remember Me
records.description: Whenever the Obsession loses a Health State by any means, Remember Me gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 3 / 4 / 5 Tokens: Increases the Opening time of both Exit Gates by a stack-able 6 seconds per Token, up to a maximum additional Opening time of 18 / 24 / 30 seconds. This results in a maximum possible Opening time of 38 / 44 / 50 seconds for both Exit Gates. Remember Me does not apply its penalty to the Obsession, allowing them to open both Exit Gates in the default time of 20 seconds. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "You don't remember? You must. You're my number one, and you'll never wake up again." — Freddy Krueger

records.name: Save the Best for Last
records.description: Identical to Keep Them Waiting.
records.flavor: "Death has come to your little town, Sheriff." — Dr Sam Loomis

records.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
records.description: At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white. Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply: The Auras of all other Survivors are revealed for 5 / 6 / 7 seconds.
records.flavor: "You form a psychic connection with The Entity and alter the rules of the Trial."

records.name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
records.description: Identical to Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds.
records.flavor: "We will tear your soul apart." — Pinhead

records.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
records.description: At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white. While carrying a Survivor, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its primary effect: The Auras of all Survivors within 12 / 14 / 16 metres of a Scourge Hook are revealed to you. Whenever a Survivor starts the Sabotage action on any Hook, Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick triggers its secondary effect: Triggers a Loud Noise Notification at the location of that Hook.
records.flavor: "Your ingenious modifications to hooks alert you of tampering." "No excuses, no equivocations... No crying." — Amanda Young

records.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
records.description: At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white. Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a normal Hook, the following effect applies: The Hook is converted into a Scourge Hook. Whenever you hook a Survivor onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies: The Aura of the Generator with the most progression is highlighted in yellow for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds.
records.flavor: "Sometimes the compass points north. Other times it points somewhere else entirely." "Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." — Portia Maye

records.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
records.description: At the start of the Trial, the 4 Hooks located inside the Basement and an additional 4 Hooks located throughout the Trial Grounds are all changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of Scourge Hooks are highlighted to you in white. Whenever you are farther than 24 metres from a Survivor hooked onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies: All Generators regress at 150 / 175 / 200 % of the default Regression rate.
records.flavor: "Your fervent care of the Hooks found in the Basement has aroused The Entity's interest." "Then you will know that there is no escape. When hanging in the depths, you face the dark one."

records.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
records.description: Overwhelming pain reverberates outwards. At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white. Start the Trial with 4 Token. Whenever a Survivor is hooked onto a Scourge Hook for the first time, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance consumes -1 Token and applies the following effects: Causes the Generator with the most progression to explode, damaging it. Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by 10 / 15 / 20 % of its total Progression. Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing afterwards. Causes all Survivors repairing the Damaged Generator to scream. This does not trigger a Loud Noise Notification. Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance is disabled for the remainder of the Trial once all Tokens are consumed.
records.flavor: "The pain spills beyond flesh/darkness staining the horizon." — Girl in the Shadow by Carmina Mora

records.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
records.description: At the start of the Trial, 4 Hooks in the environment are changed into Scourge Hooks: The Auras of these Scourge Hooks are highlighted in white. Each time a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, the following effects apply: Causes that Survivor to suffer from the Haemorrhage Status Effect for 90 seconds. After the first time that Survivor is healed back to full health, they suffer from the following effect until they are injured again by any means: Reduces their Action speeds for Healing and Repairing by 10 / 13 / 16 %.
records.flavor: "You are the bringer of sweet pain."

records.name: Secret Project
records.description: Whenever a Totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked generator becomes blocked for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds. Whenever any number of Generators become blocked, you gain Undetectable Status Effect for 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Raised to be weapon, you broke free with the very skills your captors honed within you." "You are a prisoner here, just like me" — Henry Creel

records.name: See How They Run
records.description: Losing your Obsession in a chase causes See How They Run to gain +1 Token, up to a maximum of 3 Tokens, and performing a Basic or Special Attack with the potential to damage a Survivor causes it to lose -1 Token. While having at least 1 Token, you benefit from the following effect: Grants a stack-able 3 / 4 / 5 % Haste Status Effect per Token, up to a maximum of 9 / 12 / 15 %. See How They Run has a cool-down of 10 seconds between gaining additional Tokens. You can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

records.name: Septic Touch
records.description: Whenever a Survivor performs a Healing action while inside the Terror Radius, they suffer from the following effects: Inflicts the Blindness and Exhausted Status Effects. These effects linger for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds after the Healing action is interrupted by any means.
records.flavor: "The Land of the Shadows subsumes all. Healing only delays the inevitable." "Do not admit to fear, or pain, or doubt. These are the seeds from which darkness grows." — Otto Stamper

records.name: Shadowborn
records.description: Whenever you are blinded by any means, Shadowborn triggers its effect: Grants a 6 / 8 / 10 % Haste Status Effect for 10 seconds.
records.flavor: "You have a keen vision in the darkness of the night." "Shining in the darkest dark, his eyes pierce the night and sting your soul."

records.name: Shattered Hope
records.description: To capture your prey, you must first extinguish their hope. Instead of snuffing Boon Totems you destroy them. Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed: All Totems are blocked for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds. All blessed Totem auras are revealed to you for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds.
records.flavor: "Nothing is permanent here. Nothing except our endless perdition." — Unknown, Notebook

records.name: Silent Shadow
records.description: When you hook a Survivor, you are granted Undetectable Status Effect for 11 / 12 / 13 seconds. When the Exit Gates are powered, you are granted Undetectable for the rest of the Trial.
records.flavor: "Did you see him or not? I can't put out an APB for a bad feeling." — Sgt. Reyes, Greenville Police

records.name: Sloppy Butcher
records.description: Survivors hit with your vicious Basic Attack suffer from the following effects for 70 / 80 / 90 seconds: Inflicts the Haemorrhage and Mangled Status Effects. Modifies the potency of Haemorrhage: Increases the Spawn frequency of Pools of Blood by 50 / 75 / 100 %. Increases the Regression rate of partial Healing progression by +25 %.
records.flavor: "You know where to hit to make them bleed." "It is in its sadistic nature. There is no swift kill as it delights in the obscene spectacle of our agonising suffering."

records.name: Spies from the Shadows
records.description: Whenever a Survivor startles a Crow within 36 / 38 / 40 metres of your location, Spies from the Shadows triggers its effect: Alerts you with a unique Loud Noise Notification in the shape of a Crow. Spies from the Shadows has a cool-down of 3 seconds between alerts.
records.flavor: "Allows the Crows found in the environment to directly communicate with you." "In the shadows they torment, scarring our minds with each scream."

records.name: Spirit Fury
records.description: After manually breaking a total of 4 / 3 / 2 dropped Pallets by any means, Spirit Fury activates: Instantly breaks the next Pallet used by a Survivor to stun you. Spirit Fury deactivates after use and does not affect the duration of the Pallet Stun.
records.flavor: "Each obstacle you break magnifies the wrath of The Entity." "Fury is her blood."

records.name: Starstruck
records.description: Whenever you are carrying a Survivor, Starstruck activates: Causes all other Survivors in your Terror Radius to suffer from the Exposed Status Effect. This effect lingers for 26 / 28 / 30 seconds after affected Survivors leave the Terror Radius or Starstruck deactivates. Starstruck deactivates after hooking or dropping the carried Survivor and has a cool-down of 60 seconds.
records.flavor: "Your unmatched showmanship dazzles all." "Enjoy this moment, few get so close." — Ji-Woon Hak

records.name: Stridor
records.description: You are acutely sensitive to the breathing of your prey. Increases the volume of Grunts of Pain of injured Survivors by 30 / 40 / 50 %. Increases the volume of regular breathing of Survivors by 15 / 20 / 25 %.
records.flavor: "If you do not stop and catch your breath... she will."

records.name: Superior Anatomy
records.description: Whenever a Survivor performs a Rush Vault action within 12 metres of your location, Superior Anatomy activates for 10 seconds: Increases your Vaulting speed by 30 / 35 / 40 %. Superior Anatomy has a cool-down of 20 seconds.
records.flavor: "Decades of research have culminated in you: something faster, stronger, and more dangerous than any human."

records.name: Surge
records.description: Whenever you put a Survivor into the Dying State with your Basic Attack, Surge triggers its effect: Causes all Generators within 32 metres of your location to instantly explode and start regressing. Instantly regresses all affected Generators by 6 / 7 / 8 %.
records.flavor: "Your eerie presence charges the air and interferes with technology." "The creature appears to have some unknown influence over electricity and nearby electronics." — Hawkins National Laboratory

records.name: Surveillance
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of damaged Generators are highlighted based on their current state: White Aura: The Generator is currently regressing. Yellow Aura: The Generator stopped regressing due to Survivor-intervention. This effect lasts for 8 / 12 / 16 seconds, after which the Generator Aura returns to its default colour. While Survivors are repairing Generators, they suffer from the following effect: Increases the audible range of all noises related to the Repair interaction by +8 metres.
records.flavor: "Are you gonna behave?" — Amanda Young

records.name: Terminus
records.description: Once the Exit Gates are powered, Terminus activates: Causes all injured, dying, or hooked Survivors to suffer from the Broken Status Effect. This effect last until one of the Exit Gates is opened, after which it lingers for another 35 / 40 / 45 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are a brilliant tactician who prepares for every eventuality."

records.name: Territorial Imperative
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are farther than 24 metres from its entrance, Territorial Imperative activates: The Aura of that Survivor is revealed to you for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds. Territorial Imperative has a cool-down of 45 seconds.
records.flavor: "We're not safe anywhere..."

records.name: Thanatophobia
records.description: Whenever at least one Survivor is either injured, dying, or hooked, Thanatophobia activates. While active, all Survivors suffer from the following primary effect: Incurs a stack-able 1 / 1.5 / 2 % Action-Speed penalty per injured, dying, or hooked Survivor for Cleansing, Repairing, and Sabotaging, up to a maximum of 4 / 6 / 8 %. If all four Survivors are either injured, dying, or hooked, they suffer from the following secondary effect: Increases the penalty by an additional +12 % to a total of 16 / 18 / 20 %.
records.flavor: "Their courage fades in the face of their undeniable mortality." "She plays with us and revels in our pain."

records.name: Thrilling Tremors
records.description: After picking up a Survivor, Thrilling Tremors triggers its effects: Blocks all Generators not currently being repaired by any Survivors for 16 seconds. The Auras of Blocked Generators are highlighted to you in white. Thrilling Tremors has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Your dark designs and shrewd composure rouse The Entity." "The night assists me and it's endless here." — The Ghost Face

records.name: THWACK!
records.description: Start the Trial with 3 Tokens. Whenever you break a Breakable Wall or a dropped Pallet, THWACK! consumes -1 Token and applies the following effect: Causes all Survivors within 36 metres of your location to scream and reveal their Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds. Whenever you hook a Survivor, THWACK! is granted +1 Token.
records.flavor: "Your prey is terrified by your relentless pursuit." "All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!" — Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

records.name: Tinkerer
records.description: Whenever a Generator is repaired to 70 %, you benefit from the following effects: Triggers a Loud Noise Notification for that Generator, revealing its location. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect for the next 12 / 14 / 16 seconds. Tinkerer can only trigger once per Generator per Trial.
records.flavor: "The Hillbilly makes impressive tools out of scraps. Tools aimed at maiming us in creative ways." — Notebook

records.name: Trail of Torment
records.description: Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator activates Trail of Torment: Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. The Aura of the Damaged Generator is revealed to all Survivors and highlighted in yellow. Trail of Torment deactivates after the Damaged Generator stops regressing by any means and has a cool-down of 60 / 45 / 30 seconds between activations.
records.flavor: "You guide your victims along a path of pain and punishment."

records.name: Turn Back the Clock
records.description: After hooking a Survivor, for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds, press the Active Ability button to make a target generator within 20 meters explode, lose -10 % progress, and start regressing.
records.flavor: "Resist as they might, time marches on, and your master plan comes closer to fruition." "Nothing will happen to you... Nothing that you don't deserve!" — Henry Creel

records.name: Ultimate Weapon
records.description: Whenever you search a Locker, Ultimate Weapon triggers its effects on all Survivors within 40 metres of its location: Causes them to scream and reveal their location to you. Inflicts the Blindness Status Effect for 30 seconds. Ultimate Weapon has a cool-down of 55 / 50 / 45 seconds.
records.flavor: "When they spot you, they know the end is near." "I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies." — Ash

records.name: Unbound
records.description: When a Survivor becomes injured by any means, Unbound activates for 26 / 28 / 30 seconds: Vaulting a Window while Unbound is active grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect for 25 seconds. This effect cannot stack with itself.
records.flavor: "Pain lingers in the air, an alluring aroma that excites the impulses." "I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!" — Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979

records.name: Undone
records.description: For every time you hook a Survivor, Undone gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 1 / 2 / 3 Token(s). Performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator consumes all accumulated Tokens and applies the following effects: Instantly regresses the Damaged Generator by a stack-able -10 % of its total Progression per Token, up to a maximum of 10 / 20 / 30 %. Blocks the Damaged Generator for 10 seconds per Token, up to a maximum of 10 / 20 / 30 seconds. Causes the Damaged Generator to start regressing once it becomes unblocked.
records.flavor: "Hope is the delusion that keeps its victims alive." "Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required." — OSS Report, 12/02/1943

records.name: Unforeseen
records.description: After performing the Damage Generator action on a Generator, you benefit from the following effects for 22 / 26 / 30 seconds: Transfers your Terror Radius to the damaged Generator. This Terror Radius is set to 32 metres. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect. Unforeseen has a cool-down of 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Terror takes many forms and whispers devastating lies in its victims' ears." "Mom, if you find this, I'm sorry..." — Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991

records.name: Unnerving Presence
records.description: While inside your Terror Radius, Survivors performing Repairing or Healing actions suffer from the following effects: Increases the chances of triggering a Skill Check by +10 %. Reduces the Success zone of those Skill Checks by 40 / 50 / 60 %.
records.flavor: "Your presence alone instils great fear." "Its presence befalls us."

records.name: Unrelenting
records.description: Basic Attacks benefit from the following effect: Increases the recovery speed of missed basic-attacks by 30 / 35 / 40 %. Increases the recovery speed of successful basic-attacks by 10 %.
records.flavor: "You recuperate faster from missed attacks made with your main weapon."

records.name: Wandering Eye
records.description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, Wandering Eye triggers the following effect: The Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20 metres of your location are revealed to you for 5 seconds. Wandering Eye has a cool-down of 40 / 35 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Bloodied prey surrounds you, vying for your attention." "A drop does not satiate/when a river is needed." — Elliot Campbell's "Grandeur of Samuel"

records.name: Weave Attunement
records.description: Whenever an Item is depleted for the first time, it is automatically dropped: The Auras of dropped Survivor Items are revealed to you, as well as the Auras of any Survivors within 12 metres of them. Affected Survivors see the Aura of that Item as well. Causes Survivors picking up a Survivor Item to suffer from the Oblivious Status Effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are so attuned to magical energies that you can sense even minor ripples around enchantments." "No number of novelties will protect you from me!" — Vecna

records.name: Whispers
records.description: Whenever any Survivor is within 28 / 26 / 24 metres of your location: Causes you to hear the sporadic whispers of The Entity, indicating a Survivor's presence. Whenever any Survivor is outside 28 / 26 / 24 metres of your location: Gain +5 % Haste Status Effect.
records.flavor: "You have a rudimentary understanding of The Entity's voice." "It is unclear as to the motivations of The Fog, but it is undeniable that it often takes the beast's side." — Unknown, Notebook

records.name: Zanshin Tactics
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: The Auras of Pallets and Windows are revealed to you within 32 metres. Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, Zanshin Tactics triggers the following effect: Their Aura is revealed to you for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds.
records.flavor: "You are mentally alert and aware of key points on the battlefield and nearby enemies in retreat." "Within your enemy's strength is weakness." — Renjiro's Doctrine 12:5

records.name: A Place For Us
records.description: While healing an another Survivor, both you and the healed Survivor gain Elusive Status Effect. When you finish healing the Obsession, both you and the Obsession gain Elusive Status Effect for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds. Reduces your chance of becoming the initial Obsession by reducing the default value by -100 %. The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.
records.flavor: "I understand computers… systems. Problems. But this… I wonder if I’ll ever understand." — Kwon Tae-young

records.name: Ace in the Hole
records.description: Causes all regular Items you retrieve from a Chest to come equipped with 1 to 2 Add-ons: First Slot: 100 % chance to be equipped with an Add-on of Visceral Rarity or lower. Second Slot: 50 / 75 / 100 % chance to be equipped with an Add-on of Uncommon Rarity or lower. Ace in the Hole prevents any attached Add-ons on your currently held Item to be consumed upon escaping the Trial.
records.flavor: "Lady Luck always seems to be throwing something good your way." "Everything that glitters isn't gold. But gold isn't worth a damn in this place, so this should come in handy." — Ace Visconti

records.name: Adrenaline
records.description: Once the Exit Gates are powered, Adrenaline activates and triggers the following effects: Heals you to the next Health State. Grants a +50 % Haste Status Effect for 4 seconds. Adrenaline can be used while Exhausted and ignores an existing Status Effect. Adrenaline causes the Exhausted Status Effect for 60 / 50 / 40 seconds after use.
records.flavor: "You are fuelled by unexpecting energy when on the verge of escape."

records.name: Aftercare
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability: You see the Auras of the 1 / 2 / 3 most recent Survivor(s) that helped you or vice versa: Rescued from a Hook. Completed a Healing action on. They also see your Aura. Aftercare resets its effects when you are hooked by the Killer.
