records.flavor: "Getting close to the Killer fills you with determination." "I had you, I had you on your knees. You're runnin' scared because we had you. We're gonna close this case!" — Detective David Tapp

records.name: Still Sight
records.description: After standing still for 4 / 3 / 2 seconds, Still Sight activates: The following Auras are revealed to you within 24 meters: Killer Chests Generators Still Sight deactivates once you start moving again.
records.flavor: "A clear mind and calm temperament will always find the means of their escape." "Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." — Baermar

records.name: Streetwise
records.description: Any Items with Charges you retrieve from Chests benefit from the following primary effect: Increases their Charges permanently by 60 / 70 / 80 %. Whenever your currently equipped Item is depleted for the first time, Streetwise triggers its secondary effect: The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
records.flavor: "Long nights out taught you to do a lot with what you have got." "You are doing it wrong! Let me show you how it is done." — Nea Karlsson

records.name: Strength in Shadows
records.description: Whenever you are inside the Basement, Strength in Shadows activates: Unlocks the Strength in Shadows ability, allowing you to self-heal without needing a Med-Kit at 70 % of the normal Healing speed. Upon finishing a heal in the Basement, the Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds.
records.flavor: "A chance for renewed power down where danger calls home." "I'm getting out of here, if it's the last thing I do." — Sable

records.name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
records.description: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, Teamwork: Collective Stealth activates, and both you and the Survivor who healed you benefit from the following effect: Suppresses your Scratch Marks for as long as you stay within 8 / 12 / 16 metres of one another. This effect lingers for 4 seconds once out of range and resumes upon re-entering it before that timer elapses. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Teamwork: Collective Stealth at a time.
records.flavor: "When someone helps you out, you respond in kind." "I'm good, I'm good... but keep it down." — Renato Lyra

records.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
records.description: For each Survivor repairing a generator with you, the size of the good Skill Check zone is increased by 15 / 20 / 25 %. While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5 % faster.
records.flavor: "You've dabbled with mechanical engineering and show off your abilities to others." "How many times do I have to be right on the money before you guys just trust me?" — Dustin Henderson

records.name: Teamwork: Power of Two
records.description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, Teamwork: Power of Two activates, and both you and the healed Survivor benefit from the following effect: Grants a +5 % Haste Status Effect for as long as you stay within 8 / 12 / 16 metres of one another. This effect lingers for 4 seconds once out of range and resumes upon re-entering it before that timer elapses. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Teamwork: Power of Two at a time.
records.flavor: "It is hard to keep up with you, but it does not stop people from trying." "You good? Then keep up!" — Thalita Lyra

records.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
records.description: For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range at which the Generator 's repair noise is heard is reduced by 15 / 20 / 25 %. While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5 % faster.
records.flavor: "You look out for your friends, using your abilities to protect them." "I make my own rules." — Eleven

records.name: Teamwork: Throw Down
records.description: Whenever you blind the Killer by any means or stun them using a Pallet, Teamwork: Throw Down triggers its effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect to all other injured Survivors within 24 metres of your location for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds.
records.flavor: "You know the best way to even the odds is to empower those around you." "Facing evil brings good people together." — Michonne Grimes

records.name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
records.description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24 metres of your location blinds the Killer by any means or stuns them using a Pallet, Teamwork: Toughen Up triggers its effect: Suppresses your Grunts of Pain, and the creation of Pools of Blood and Scratch Marks for 20 / 25 / 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "You maintain your composure under immense amounts of pain." "They're fucking with the wrong people." — Rick Grimes

records.name: Technician
records.description: While repairing a Generator, the following effects apply: Reduces the audible range of all noises related to the Repair interaction by -16 metres. Increases the Progression penalty incurred when failing a Skill Check by 4 / 3 / 2 %. Suppresses the explosion of the Generator and the Loud Noise Notification usually triggered by that.
records.flavor: "You are apt at handling machinery with the greatest care and precision." "I am gonna stealth this one." — Feng Min

records.name: Tenacity
records.description: Your ferocious tenacity in dire situations allows you to benefit from the following effects while in the Dying State: Grants the ability to recover while crawling. Grants a 30 / 40 / 50 % Haste Status Effect. Reduces the volume of Grunts of Pain by -75 %. Blocks your Aura from being read.
records.flavor: "There is nothing stopping you." "What the hell is this? I'm taking this bastard down!" — Detective David Tapp

records.name: This Is Not Happening
records.description: While repairing or healing, This Is Not Happening activates: Increases the Success zone for a Good Skill Check by 150 / 175 / 200 %.
records.flavor: "You perform at your best when you are under extreme stress."

records.name: Troubleshooter
records.description: When you are chased by the Killer, Troubleshooter activates: The Aura of the Generator with the most progress is revealed to you. The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 4 / 5 / 6 seconds after dropping a Pallet. These effects linger for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds after ending the Chase, after which Troubleshooter deactivates.
records.flavor: "No amount of distraction will shake you from your primary task." "Nothing gets done around here if I don't do it." — Gabriel Soma

records.name: Unbreakable
records.description: Whenever you are put in the Dying State by the Killer, Unbreakable activates: Increases your Recovery speed by 25 / 30 / 35 %. Unlocks the Self-Recovery ability, allowing you to fully recover from the Dying State. This ability can only be used once per Trial.
records.flavor: "Past battles have taught you a thing or two about survival." "Goddammit, I am seriously FUBAR!" — Bill Overbeck

records.name: Up the Ante
records.description: Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage for all Survivors. For every Survivor still in the Trial, Up the Ante is granted +1 Token: Increases the Luck at succeeding Self-Unhook attempts for all Survivors by a stack-able 1 / 2 / 3 % per Token, up to a maximum of 3 / 6 / 9 %.
records.flavor: "All will be well in the end; you just know it. Your confidence strengthens the feeling of hope for those around you." "What can I say? I'm just a very lucky guy... I'm sure some of it will rub off on you." — Ace Visconti

records.name: Urban Evasion
records.description: You benefit from the following permanent effect: Increases your Movement speed while crouched by 90 / 95 / 100 %.
records.flavor: "Years of evading the cops taught you a thing or two about stealth." "The paint is still fresh but I am long gone." — Nea Karlsson

records.name: Valkyrie's Rage
records.description: Valkyrie's Rage activates after being chased for 40 / 35 / 30 seconds: The next time you Pallet -stun the Killer, they are stunned for +75 % longer. Valkyrie's Rage then deactivates.
records.flavor: "I hope that hurt, fucker!" — Sienna Shaw

records.name: Vigil
records.description: You recover 20 / 25 / 30 % faster from the following: The Exhausted Status Effect. Vigil extends its effect to all Survivors within 16 metres of your location and lingers for 15 seconds after leaving its Area of Effect. Survivors can only be affected by one instance of Vigil at a time.
records.flavor: "You watch over your friends, even in dire situations." "I am gonna be here when you wake up. You are gonna make it." — Quentin Smith

records.name: Visionary
records.description: You benefit from the following permanent effect: The Auras of Generators are revealed to you within 32 metres. Visionary is temporarily deactivated for 20 / 18 / 16 seconds whenever a Generator is completed.
records.flavor: "You are remarkably focused on your means of escape."

records.name: Wake Up!
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. Once all Generators are completed, Wake Up! activates: The Auras of the Exit Gate Switches are revealed to you permanently while within 128 metres. Your Aura is revealed to all other Survivors within 128 metres while you are opening an Exit Gate. Increases your Gate-Opening speed by 8 / 9 / 10 % and by an additional #effect for each Survivor still alive in the Trial up to a maximum of 68 / 69 / 70 %.
records.flavor: "Ok, look. If we survive the next 24 hours, then I'll take you out on a real date." — Quentin Smith

records.name: We'll Make It
records.description: After unhooking another Survivor, We'll Make It activates for 70 / 80 / 90 seconds: Increases your Altruistic Healing speed by +100 %.
records.flavor: "Helping others heightens your morale." "I am confident we can all escape in one piece if we help each other."

records.name: We're Gonna Live Forever
records.description: Your few friends deserve the best protection. You benefit from the following effect when healing a dying Survivor: Increases your Healing speed by +100 %. Any dying Survivor you heal back to the Injured State benefits from the following effect: Grants the Endurance Status Effect for 6 / 8 / 10 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once every 30 seconds.
records.flavor: "Come on then, let's ave' it! I don't give a shit pal." — David King

records.name: We See You
records.description: Gain a token when the Killer reveals your Aura. When you have 4 tokens, they are all consumed, and the Killer 's aura is revealed to you and all other Survivors for 10 / 12.5 / 15 seconds. This perk has a 10-second cool-down when gaining a token.
records.flavor: "You've honed your powers and can turn the tables on those who try to find you." "It is not me. It is you. You are the monster." — Eleven

records.name: Wicked
records.description: After you are unhooked by any means, Wicked triggers the following effect: The Aura of the Killer is revealed to you for 16 / 18 / 20 seconds. While hooked inside the Basement, Wicked potentially triggers the following effect: First Hook Stage: 100 % to succeed an attempted Self-Unhook. Second Hook Stage: Does not trigger the effect. Last Survivor Standing: Does not trigger the effect.
records.flavor: "They can try to hurt you. But you're not going down so easily." "I haven't let anyone get in my way before. You think I'm gonna start now?" — Sable

records.name: Wide Open Throttle
records.description: Fast-vaulting a Pallet triggers the following effects: Gain 10 / 12.5 / 15 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds. The Pallet is immediately reset, blocked by the Entity and revealed to all Survivors for 60 seconds. This perk then goes on a 60 second cool-down.
records.flavor: "Nothing but the open road. Just the way I like it." — Shane Wiigwaas

records.name: Will to Live
records.description: Using whatever is at hand, you stab your aggressor in an ultimate attempt to escape. After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Will to Live activates for the next 40 / 50 / 60 seconds: When grabbed or picked up by the Killer, succeed a Skill Check to stab the Killer and escape from their grasp. Stuns the Killer for 4 seconds. Causes you to become the next Obsession. Will to Live is deactivated once the Exit Gates are powered. Will to Live is disabled for the remainder of the Trial after use. Will to Live is deactivated prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action. Increases your chance of becoming the initial Obsession by increasing the default value by +100 %. The Killer can only be obsessed with one Survivor at a time.

records.name: Windows of Opportunity
records.description: Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability. The Auras of Windows are revealed to you within 24 metres. You vault Windows +10 % faster. Windows of Opportunity goes on a 40 / 35 / 30 seconds cool-down when you vault a Window.
records.flavor: "Rise and shine, work hard, carve out your name, Take aim, pull the trigger, hit the bulls eye for fame, Know the value of faith, an' family, and don't you complain, Open wide, your windows of opportunity" — Kate Denson's "Windows of Opportunity"

records.name: Wiretap
records.description: After repairing a Generator for the equivalent of 40 % of Progression, Wiretap activates. While active, press the Active Ability button while standing next to a Generator to install a listening device to it with a countdown of 100 / 110 / 120 seconds: Reveals the Aura of the Killer coming within 14 metres of the Bugged Generator to all Survivors. The listening device is deactivated after its countdown has elapsed or the Bugged Generator is damaged. The Auras of Bugged Generators are revealed to all Survivors in yellow.
records.flavor: "You know that the best way to stay one step ahead is to keep tabs on the competition."
